port.description: The port the app listens on inside the preview.

health_probe_path.description: The path Yak requests to check the preview is up. Starts with a slash.

cold_start.description: The command that starts the app from a stopped preview.

checkout_refresh.description: The command that refreshes a preview after a new commit.

wake_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a sleeping preview to wake.

cold_start_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the cold start command to finish.

checkout_refresh_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the checkout refresh command to finish.

health_probe_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the health probe to answer.
